create_NllbTokenizer: create an NllbTokenizer instance from a pretrained model with source and target language codes for translation
build_prepare_seq2seq_batch: build a batched seq2seq input with source texts, target texts, language codes, and labels for NLLB translation training
run__build_translation_inputs: run translation input preparation with source text, target language code, and forced bos token id for generation
set_src_lang_special_tokens: set source language special tokens with prefix or suffix language code and eos token for NLLB tokenization
set_tgt_lang_special_tokens: set target language special tokens with prefix or suffix language code and eos token for NLLB tokenization
